sources.fullCitation: Three Smart Girls (Universal Pictures, 1936), US lobby card, captioned from left with Mischa Auer and Barbara Read. Alamy stock image, contributor Everett Collection Inc, photographer credited as “Courtesy Everett Collection”, date taken 1936; 2961 × 2325 pixels. Alamy supplies it as a handout or public-domain image, granting access only and no warranty as to copyright.
sources.title: Three Smart Girls (1936) — US lobby card

sources.researchNote: A reverse image search matched the local reproduction to this image, and the same card is offered elsewhere from the Everett Collection. The image details were read in a browser on 6 November 2026; the page refuses automated requests. The card itself prints a 1936 copyright notice for Universal Pictures Corporation, so the agency’s public-domain description is not adopted here.
